count_source: Released GEO nonnegative integer matrices; upstream SoupX or other correction not established by integer appearance. Deliverable X/counts remain unchanged; all native features retained.
cell_calling: No independent EmptyDrops: no positive-UMI<=100 background barcodes in any released matrix. Provenance-screened released candidate barcodes; ambient correction not rerun without unfiltered background.
author_QC: GSE255296 GEO Cell Ranger6.0.1; paper PMC12054467 uses SoupX1.6.1 and DoubletFinder2.0.3 but application to deposited matrices is unverified. GSE292754 only new P186/P194 retained. This batch applies agreed project nuclear numeric baseline and audits sample loss.
doublet_model: scDblFinder per capture on all >=500-gene released barcodes, including high MT and >5000 genes; dbr=NULL,dbr.per1k=.008. Screening heuristic: true loading and upstream doublet history unknown.
doublet_exclusion: Algorithmic doublet AND strong mixed pair (3 genes each >=2 UMI in each lineage, both program means >=max(reference positive q10,negative q99), smaller/larger>=.25). Algorithm-only calls retained if other CM evidence passes; same-lineage doublets not excluded reliably.
identity: Fixed adult-LV reference and donor-held-out calibration; SingleR raw/pruned labels, marker panels and contextual support. Pediatric/region domain shift remains explicit.
CM_core: Best/pruned reference both CM, >=2 detected CM markers, CM program dominance, reference-tail pass OR >=3 CM markers and >=.5 CM-anchor neighborhood support; no strong mixed flag.
CM_pending: Best-reference CM or >=3 CM markers and CM program dominance, failing core and not jointly excluded; not tokenized.
graph: Separate log1p CP10k diagnostic copy; <=3000 shared non-MT HVGs, <=40 PCs, 15 exact neighbors, Leiden .6; no disease-based integration.
feature_space: Native Ensembl union, full feature axes and per-capture availability mask; structural missingness is not observed zero.
light: <=20000 unique CM cores, balanced across source donor identifiers; no duplication.
replicate_policy: GSE255296 has four deposited human samples only; reused Chin controls/HCM excluded from new download. GSE292754 P86 and reused controls excluded. Cross-study donor independence not proven.
clinical_stage: GSE255296 septal myectomy; age/sex unresolved. GSE292754 pediatric end-stage LV explants P186/P194. Both released subsets HCM-only; not standalone HCM-v-Control cohorts.
scope: QC then separate Geneformer V1 serialization only; no DGE, training or in-silico perturbation.
